svg.title: Tester malfunction timeline
svg.desc: A timeline from 170 s to 235 s after the competition started. Top: tester 1's readings in volts. They stay near 3.6 V, drop to -1 at 180 s, stay at -1 until 225 s, then return to about 3.6 V. Below, three rows. Status: OPERATIONAL, then MALFUNCTIONING from 180 s to 225 s, then OPERATIONAL. Watcher: UP, DOWN from 180 s to 225 s, UP. Tree uses: both testers, then tester 2 only (a new plan), then both testers again (a new plan). Tag 1 marks 180 s, where the failure starts; tag 2 marks 225 s, where it ends.
